  no sorry/admit/axiom in source (the only occurrences are in the header prose); no arbitrary real presented as the paper datum.

KEY FINDING (IUT I, Def 3.1(f), p. 63; local extract papers/motizuki_corpus/text/Inter-universal Teichmuller Theory I.txt lines 3123-3126, 3273-3280):
  Definition 3.1 defines initial Theta-data as (F/Fbar, X_F, l, C_K, V, V^bad_mod, epsilon) and (f) says epsilon IS A CUSP of C_K arising from a nonzero element of the quotient Q, and for v in V^bad the cusp epsilon_v is the one arising from the canonical generator ±1 of the local Zhat quotient. There is NO real number in (f).
  Therefore SourceCuspClause.epsilon : Real and S1881RealCuspCoordinate are numerical shells, not the paper D8. The paper's (f) is exactly the object the Lean source calls the D9 cusp (TorsionQuotientBoundaryOrigin), consistent with coord/reports/S1355-d9-torsion-cusp-audit.md:42.

WHAT IS FORMALIZED:
1. S1889PaperCuspDatum l S := TorsionQuotientBoundaryOrigin l (S1732A l) S.cK; proved:
   - S1889PaperCuspDatum_nonempty_iff_D9Cusp : Nonempty ... <-> S1881D9CuspMissing l S;
   - S1889PaperCuspDatum_residual : <-> exists Q, Nonempty (S1881CuspBoundaryResidual (X := S.cK) Q);
   - arisesFromNonzeroClass (distinguished nonzero class maps to the cusp), canonicalGenerator (image = 1, i.e. ±1).
2. S1881's real shell is VACUOUS (proved, clearly labelled, not offered as paper data):
   - S1889ConstantRealCuspCoordinate (eps = any e>0, scale = e^-1, compatibility = True);
   - S1889D8Missing_trivially_true : forall S, S1881D8Missing l S;
   - S1889D8Missing_iff_slot / S1889D8RealFirstMissing : (exists S, D8Missing l S) <-> Nonempty (S1881D9OrbicurveSlot l);
   - S1889RealCuspCoordinate_not_determined : two coordinates differ at the same cusp; S1889ScaleRealCuspCoordinate: arbitrary positive rescaling; S1889TrueCompatibilityCoordinate: compatibility can always be made True;
   - S1889CuspClause_epsilon_arbitrary : every e>0 is the epsilon of some SourceCuspClause (S1889CuspClauseOfEpsilon); S1889CuspClause_nonempty_trivially.
   CONSEQUENCE: constructing the S1881 real coordinate is not progress; the D8-real leg adds NO obligation beyond the D9 orbicurve slot. Do not count it as a source-faithful result.
3. Only non-arbitrary real route (conditional, genuine geometry):
   S1889CuspQParameter l S v = nonzero contracting cusp parameter q : cusp -> Completion v (||q c|| < 1) with a proved actuality Prop; S1889CuspQParameter.realCuspCoordinate has epsilonOf c = ||q c|| (positive and <1 by contracting), scale = inverse norm, product = 1; cuspClause = S1881CuspClauseOfCoordinate at that coordinate. S1889ActualPlaceAboveFive := S1720PlaceAboveFive (actual place above 5, K = S1720Field definitionally); exact missing input there is S1889ActualCuspQParameterRequired l S.

EXACT FIRST MISSING (same for paper-faithful and real readings): S1881D9OrbicurveSlot l. Its first field is S1889FirstMissing := S1881CF l, the F-side quotient orbicurve C_F of type (1,1)^± (S1881 already proves the actual S1726 orbicurve is not C_F/C_K/X_K by signature). No cusp of C_K exists before C_F; the paper's place-indexed part of (f) (epsilon_v from the canonical generator of the local (1,1,Z/lZ)^± orbicurve C_v) additionally needs the base-changed C_v, also downstream of C_K.

RECOMMENDATION: treat S1732's D8 real leg as non-obstructive. For source fidelity either drop/relabel SourceCuspClause.epsilon (paper (f) = the D9 cusp origin, already isolated) or keep it only as the conditional norm-of-cusp-parameter normalization. The real frontier is C_F / C_K (D9 slot), not a real number.
